note: Machine-readable submission gate. place_bid automation may run IFF every precondition holds; otherwise it must raise FounderAuthorizationRequired. This policy authorizes BOUNDS, not any specific bid — each bid still needs a qualified opportunity + passed QA + idempotency key.
proposal_submission_preconditions: opportunity passes qualification (VERIFIED OPEN via public API)
no additional spending (bid free; buyer pays on delivery via escrow)
no binding contract created by bidding
duplicate submission prevented (idempotency: one bid per project_id)
